Who I Am

Turning Ideas Into Reality

I'm Hasibur Rahman Hemal, a Computer Science & Engineering student at North South University, Bangladesh. I'm deeply passionate about building things — whether it's software that solves real problems or businesses that create real value.

Beyond the classroom, I founded Rivoré, a perfume startup that blends artisan craftsmanship with modern branding. It taught me that entrepreneurship is just engineering applied to real life.

I'm currently exploring AI automation — training myself to build intelligent systems that can augment human potential. My goal is to merge my CSE foundation with AI to create impactful products.

My Venture

Rivoré — Perfume Startup

✨ Founder & COO

Rivoré is my entrepreneurial venture into the world of artisan fragrances. The brand is built around the belief that scent is identity — personal, powerful, and poetic.

As the founder, I manage everything from product development and sourcing to brand storytelling and customer experience. Rivoré has taught me how to build from scratch — budgeting, branding, and bootstrapping a real product.

It's where my engineering mindset meets the world of luxury and lifestyle. Every decision is data-driven, every campaign is intentional.
